in_marathi.name: Hanumantha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hanumantha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Refers to Lord Hanuman assuming a form to help Rama in his quest for Sita. This name represents strength, loyalty, and devotion.
